description: This file contains Python code defining a web request processing pipeline with classes and functions for content resolution, tokenization, response modification, and templating, specifically for a web testing framework (WPT).

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Class representing a sequence of pipe functions to process HTTP responses.

classes.name: PipeTokenizer
classes.description: Tokenizer class for parsing pipe function strings into tokens.

classes.name: ReplacementTokenizer
classes.description: Tokenizer class for parsing template substitution expressions.

classes.name: FirstWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class for accessing the first element of a parameter collection.

methods.name: resolve_content
methods.description: Reads and encodes response content, handling unicode.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a pipe string into a list of functions and arguments.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Executes the sequence of pipe functions on a request and response.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Generator that yields tokens from a string based on current state.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Decorator that registers a function as a pipe with argument conversion.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Converts an argument using the wrapped function.

methods.name: inner
methods.description: Wraps a function to handle nullable conversion.

methods.name: boolean
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean value.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Sets or appends an HTTP header.

methods.name: trickle
methods.description: Splits response content into chunks with delays.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Slices response content by byte range.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Performs template substitution in response content.

methods.name: gzip
methods.description: Gzip-encodes response content and sets headers.
